description: A young/teenage girl who, while babysitting infant stepbrother Toby, imagines goblins carrying him away and then enters a maze of illusion to bring him back. Jim Henson Company material calls her Sarah Williams.

supports: Sarah babysits Toby, enters the maze, and seeks to bring him back.

description: The Goblin King who governs the kingdom containing the labyrinth. Official Jim Henson Company material identifies Jareth as the figure Sarah must face while seeking Toby and describes him taunting Sarah during her attempt to reach her brother.
